title: Synchronize published ReMCP 0.2.213 Windows improvements and accelerate Windows service status.
changes: Preserve the full published 0.2.213 runtime and Windows client fixes, including Unicode clipboard reading, signed scroll deltas, startup recovery and terminal quoting; retain their regression tests.
Query Windows SCM through native sc.exe for read-only service status, avoiding PowerShell startup delays on heavily loaded virtual machines while preserving JSON status fields.
Fall back to the previous PowerShell service reader for unexpected or localized SCM output; keep all service mutation permissions unchanged.
Add a native Windows CI check for the service status fast path and diagnostics module API contract.

Start the managed Windows logon task through a hidden Windows Script Host wrapper, so the persistent ReMCP agent no longer leaves a visible terminal window; retain interactive, least-privilege startup, crash recovery and safe uninstall.
Preserve public-first source parity, authentication constraints, path restrictions and normal release checks; do not replace production agents before package release.
